ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 lb smoked sausage, sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
directions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and all-purpose seasoning. Cook in oil in a large pot over medium heat until browned and cooked through.
Remove chicken from pot, preserving the oil.
Sauté onions and garlic in remaining oil for 3–4 minutes.
Add bell pepper, celery, parsley, and scallions. Sauté until onions are transparent, about 10 minutes.
Add sausage, rice, broth, chicken, salt, cayenne, bay leaves, thyme, and gumbo filé if using.
Cook over medium heat until nearly all water is absorbed into the rice, about 15–20 minutes.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until rice is done, at least 1 hour.
